title: The Sphere Packing Problem in Dimension 4
content: We prove the \(D_4\) Voronoi-cell bound for root-aligned saturated unit-ball packings in \(\mathbb R^4\): every cell has volume at least \(8\), with equality only for the scaled lattice \(\sqrt2\,D_4\). The remaining cap-cutting geometry is reduced by a monotonicity theorem to an all-contact \(176\)-chamber positivity system over \(\mathbb Q(\sqrt2)\).
